doNow.prompt: A pupil says a magnet will attract any metal object. What is wrong with this idea?

choices.text: Yes: if it is a metal, a magnet will pull it
choices.misconception: A magnet attracts every kind of metal.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option Yes: if it is a metal, a magnet will pull it as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of testing each metal to check whether a magnet pulls it.
rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: A magnet attracts every kind of metal.. Magnets grab some metals so strongly that they feel like they grab all of them. Magnets ignore most things: they only pull iron and a few metals. In the animation scene s4 the warning is spelled out in the caption itself - a magnet does not attract every metal - so test each metal instead of trusting the shine.
